purpose: Govern Current Evidence → Position Correspondence → Transition Signals → Observation Threshold → Reachable Positions without creating a parallel runtime or filling missing current facts by inference.

pipeline.rule: Search/discovery output is not fact or authority.
Requires provenance, authority class, freshness and dated evidence admission.
Current evidence enters the existing Reality Readout Engine; missing evidence remains visible.
A candidate runtime position may be proposed only from admitted evidence and explicit reasoning lineage; no date-only mapping.
Primary/secondary/subsystem correspondence remains unadmitted until human review.
A registered observation target becomes an observed signal only when admitted evidence supports direction/change.
Threshold review is qualitative and evidence-addressed; no synthetic score.
Reachability is conditional projection only and must list enabling/closing conditions and unknowns.

observationThresholdCriteria.rule: 变化必须持续存在，而不是一次异常。
变化开始跨越多个子系统，而不是局部孤立波动。
原有反馈关系已经改变，同一种输入不再产生过去的结果。

observationThresholdCriteria.labelZh: 路径依赖／难以恢复旧态
observationThresholdCriteria.rule: 新结构开始形成，系统越来越难完全回到原来的运行状态。

rules: No automatic position assignment from source phase date.
No automatic position assignment from one current metric or one event.
No universal score or weighted ranking is created.
Structural knowledge and observation targets remain readable while CURRENT_DATA is absent.
UNKNOWN is a valid field-scoped output.
